works.name: Action Model · Connector Research
works.summary: A verified research dossier on OSS connector catalogues for the Action Model app builder: which catalogues can legally power a hosted connect-your-account section, a live spike of the leading gateway, the multi-tenancy boundary, and the resulting build order.

works.name: Action Model · SISO Agency Assembly Framework
works.summary: Reusable methods for agents to assemble software from existing capabilities, bounded adaptation and verification, with a public human/agent Blueprint and a private owning source. Public metadata only; registration does not admit source payload or prove a production integration.

works.name: GQ-001 · The Agent Workspace
works.summary: A standing research question about the complete code, agent, memory, enforcement, and user-interface architecture of an agent-native workspace.

works.name: GQ-002 · 10× the Agent Layer
works.summary: A standing research question about making a provider-neutral multi-agent operating layer materially more effective, efficient, observable, and self-improving.

works.name: Declassified Document Corpus (CREST, NARA, Black Vault, NSArchive, DOE)
works.summary: A bulk-available catalogue of public-domain declassified government documents — CIA CREST (incl. Stargate/remote-viewing), the NARA AWS Catalog and JFK release tranches, the National Security Archive (GWU free site), DOE OpenNet, and The Black Vault curated FOIA archive — with full provenance and per-unit rights posture. The Great Library holds the inventory; SISO Knowledge holds the durable corpus; Foundry owns source discovery; Evidence Engines perform source-grounded transformation.

works.name: Herdr
works.summary: An externally owned terminal-native multiplexer providing persistent workspaces, tabs, panes, and addressable agent sessions.
